nodes.name: Daily at 08:00
nodes.notes: Schedule trigger, NOT a webhook. This workflow has no inbound HTTP surface, which is required: no public webhook is exposed by this deployment.

nodes.name: Send Telegram notification
nodes.notes: OUTBOUND ONLY. Create the credential in the n8n UI (Credentials → Telegram API) and paste the bot token there. The token is encrypted at rest with N8N_ENCRYPTION_KEY and is never included in a workflow export.

meta.description: Example outbound Telegram notification. Import via n8n UI → Workflows → Import from File. IMPORTANT: this file contains NO credentials — the bot token must be entered once in the n8n credential store, and the chat id is read from the PC_TELEGRAM_CHAT_ID environment variable. Never paste a token into a workflow node, because workflow JSON is exported in plaintext.
